description: Terracotta jali tile from Pak Clay with a panel of mixed fine lattice patterns. Made from fired clay in Lahore, it lets air and filtered light pass while partly screening the view, so it suits screens, courtyards and feature walls. Natural clay has a warm colour with slight variation from piece to piece, and clay is porous, so ask your mason about fixing and cleaning. Confirm the exact size and thickness before you plan the wall. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your city, opening size and use for a dated quote.
